claims.summary: In the charged binary quotient through degree at least two, a cycle edge gives a fixed three-query multiplicativity conflict for every normalized circulation-invariant linear answer map.
claims.assessment: Working proof: circulation invariance makes all three label answers equal to one in characteristic two, whereas two distinct labels multiply to zero. Does not reject adaptive, nonlinear or source-restricted answer strategies.
claims.rationale: Uniform obstruction to one symmetry-based design shortcut; no Frege lower bound or independent novelty claim.
claims.next_action: Develop source-specific strategies only with an actual quantitative success guarantee.

claims.summary: Over F2, any ordinary-PC degree-D refutation of Boolean A B=I for A of size (n+1) by n and B of size n by (n+1) yields functional unary PHP degree max(D,2); impossible for D>=2 and n>=2D-1.
claims.assessment: Known rank-principle/PHP reduction, explicitly verified in ordinary PC: identify A_ij and B_ji with X_ij, derive diagonals using Booleanity and row sums, and off-diagonals from column collisions. Bounded exact matrix controls pass. Does not instantiate a complete Frege/ENS compiler or meet a near-half-variable target.
claims.rationale: Published order-two tensor-rank reduction recorded with exact local conventions, not a new hardness theorem.
claims.next_action: Develop the queued rank-family nonlinear interface before adopting this family.

claims.summary: For a finite nonzero vector space V over any field, subspaces X_i with mutual relative-dimension independence from all nonneighbor intersections and 1-R(X_i)<=y_i product_{j in N_i}(1-y_j), 0<=y_i<1, satisfy R(intersection X_i)>=product_i(1-y_i)>0.
claims.assessment: Imported Ambainis-Kempe-Sattath Theorem 13 in the cited conference version (Theorem 14 in the longer version). The full dimension-only induction extends to finite fields. Application to weighted polynomial kernels additionally requires bounded multiplication closure, paid degree windows and proved conditional-dimension hypotheses.
claims.rationale: Established subspace local lemma provides a possible alternative to a global rank sum; its actual-source dependency premise remains open.
claims.next_action: Develop the queued weighted conditional-dimension bridge without assuming disjoint-support independence.

claims.summary: Over any field, every nonzero Boolean polynomial function supported on invertible s by s matrices has multilinear degree at least s, including with spectator variables; determinant attains s.
claims.assessment: Working proof: zeroing any row annihilates the function, so every surviving multilinear monomial meets every row. Exact binary size-one and size-two controls corroborate the statement. Old relations and partial pivots are outside this unrestricted Boolean support statement.
claims.rationale: Support-degree cost for the proposed Schur-complement bridge; does not exclude all rational certificates.
claims.next_action: Account explicitly for pivot-support degree when testing partial-pivot certificate transformations.

relationships: Uses the degree-preserving cycle action on binary label indicators and the charged quotient.
Uses the binary quotient and its local one-hot identities.
Uses the exact functional unary PHP PC barrier n>=2D-1 after degree-two axiom substitution.
Related denominator-support obstruction, with an independent row-restriction proof for full symbolic pivots.
The earlier one-sided conditional-rank criterion is the stronger available weighted-source interface; this classical exact-independence import is an attributed comparison, not a new route.
The degree-one calibration reproduced here is a special case of the existing all-cutoff disjoint-conjunction obstruction.
